title: What is a Slice?
overview: A slice is a collection of Redux state, reducers, and actions for a specific feature of an application.

title: Creating a Slice
overview: Redux Toolkit provides createSlice() to create a slice with initial state, reducers, and automatically generated actions.

example.title: createSlice Example

title: Slice State
overview: Each slice manages its own part of the application state. This keeps state organized and easier to maintain.

title: Slice Reducers
overview: Reducers inside a slice define how the state changes when specific actions are dispatched.

title: Exporting Actions and Reducers
overview: Slices automatically generate action creators which can be exported and used inside components.

example.title: Export Example
example.content:
export const { login } = userSlice.actions;

export default userSlice.reducer;

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how slices organize Redux logic using state, reducers, and generated actions with createSlice.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ Slice manages feature state.
✔ createSlice creates reducers and actions.
✔ Slices keep Redux code organized.
